decisions: Row ids are lowercase composition.*/property.*/keyframe.*/expression.* because the business-event envelope admits only [a-z0-9._-]{1,64}; spec_id() maps each to its STUDIO_* id and Run::motion_command accepts both
Record edits are document entries: entry-only steps make no document revision (existing reading); a layer-creating step also commits the document layer, grouped as one history step
harness-core names no serde trait (no serde edge): typed decoding via macros, no Cargo change
The evaluator for add-at-current mirrors motion keyframe::shape (no harness-core edge to motion); pinned by the media test against composite scene evaluation
